messages:
olivia_m: Quick note: I ran a broad smoke/scorecard for Trident-11B (fp16 -> int6) across our GTN slices. Unit econ looks attractive but there's a hit on reranking precision and a small pop in hallucination on long spans.
taylan_s: numbers plz?
olivia_m: Perf: 2.2k tok/s p99 (batch=16), median latency 72ms. Cost roughly 0.015 $/1k tokens int6 vs 0.038 fp16 -> ~60% token cost drop.
ravi_k: nice savings. How big is the quality delta?
olivia_m: On rerank-recall slice A: MRR down from 0.42 -> 0.36 (-14%). Extractive QA F1 down 4 points on >1024-context tasks. BLEU/ROUGE for short summaries essentially flat.
kyle_prod: From product, rerank drops worry me. What % of traffic is rerank-heavy?
olivia_m: ~12% of TD tokens are rerank/recall-heavy; long-context QA ~9%. If we route those to fp16 fallback, avg cost becomes ~0.024 $/1k tokens (still ~37% savings).
jen_ops: We can implement a routing rule by route-tag or token-estimate. Cost of routing logic ~12ms added p99. Ops impact minimal.
taylan_s: Can we engineer a lighter-weight fix on model side? e.g., per-head bias correction or layer-wise minmax recal?
olivia_m: I ran per-head scale tuning on layers 18-26 which improved MRR loss to -8% and QA F1 loss to -2 points (on a 1k sample). Full GTN sweep queued to confirm.
ci-bot: Pipeline queued: trident11b-int6-recal-3060001234 (est 1h).
ravi_k: Good. If recal brings MRR delta <= -5% and F1 <= -2, we could ship int6 with targeted fallback and A/B monitor.
kyle_prod: Agree. Need pre-comm to GTN: expected ~35-40% cost saving, coverage of fallback, and instructions for reporting regressions.
taylan_s: Also capture top-20 worst prompts and add guardrail rules (e.g., force fp16 for >1.5k context or for rerank endpoint).
jen_ops: I'll add a rollout flag and threshold-based revert for the canary. Revert automation if error rate or MRR regression exceed thresholds.
olivia_m: Plan: 1) finish GTN sweep, 2) attach diffs + top failure prompts, 3) run a short canary (5% traffic) w/ routing + observability dashboards.
kyle_prod: Set a 48h canary and post a one-pager. Tagging @kyle_prod for approvals.
ci-bot: Canary job created: trident11b-int6-canary-3060001234 :white_check_mark:
olivia_m: Thanks team 609. Will post final numbers here after the sweep.
